description: This header file defines 128-bit integer types (`uint128` and `int128`) with constructors, conversion operators, arithmetic, comparison, and utility functions, including support for intrinsic compiler types and platform-specific details.

classes.name: uint128
classes.description: An unsigned 128-bit integer type supporting arithmetic, conversions, and bitwise operations.

classes.name: int128
classes.description: A signed 128-bit integer type supporting arithmetic, conversions, and bitwise operations.

methods.name: MakeUint128
methods.description: Constructs a uint128 from two 64-bit unsigned integers.

methods.name: MakeInt128
methods.description: Constructs an int128 from two 64-bit integers.

methods.name: Uint128Max
methods.description: Returns the maximum value of uint128.

methods.name: Int128Max
methods.description: Returns the maximum value of int128.

methods.name: Int128Min
methods.description: Returns the minimum value of int128.
